title: My first vibe-coded game, a Pokémon catching simulator, with some extra stuff!.
author: Separate_Gap_6666
selftext: It's kind of a rough beta patch, I haven't gotten anyone to play it yet, except my dad. Please try it out and give me feedback!

comments.author: Tenoihero
comments.body: Audio would be good along with animations during movement

replies.author: Separate_Gap_6666
replies.body: Walking frames, footstep sounds, and Pokémon cries should be live in their first iteration, just reload your game, it saves automatically. For your help, here's a beta tester mystery gift code: CL0V3R-F0UND3RS

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Separate_Gap_6666 please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: Separate_Gap_6666
replies.body: I edited it to fit your restrictions better, I hope?

replies.author: Separate_Gap_6666
replies.body: I can find another sub if this isn't the place for asking what to add to AI games, could you tell me what that is?

replies.author: Separate_Gap_6666
replies.body: I realize commercial was not the right tag, im not trying to make money off of this at all i just wanted to show it to people.
